learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to use fun little words like He, She, and It in place of names!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use 'He' when we talk about one boy or man. Your father, brother, and grandfather are all 'He'.
We use 'She' when we talk about one girl or woman. Your mother, sister, and grandmother are all 'She'.
We use 'It' when we talk about an animal, a bird, or a thing. Your pet dog, your pencil, and your toy are all 'It'.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Point and Say Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Point to your family members and say 'He' or 'She'. Then point to your toys or a pet and say 'It'!
